operand_ready.proof: Same full barrier is published after V transpose and awaited before QK(next). Four K-ready arrivals after cp_wait/proxy fence are sufficient for QK.
operand_ready.elision: K-ready(rr+1) implies V-ready(rr): every producer warp publishes V(rr) before advancing to K(rr+1). Drop only the step PV(rr) wait; final PV retains V(rlast) wait.

kmajor.old: K bytes widened into half B fragments for mma.sync m16n8k16; query M16 has eight padded rows at q1.
kmajor.new: Native RS QK M64 cached keys xN8queries, twoK32 issues/head; Q rounded to allowed E4M3; existing FP16-P PV and new-token path retained.

parity.old: Single online m/l/O state per query; each next softmax rescales same O.
parity.new: Two statically indexed parity chains preserve QK(next)/PV(current) overlap; exact log-domain weighted merge at portion end, including new token. Control transfers registers with original single state.
parity.register_budget: 2x128x232 +128x32 =63488 registers<=65536; same launch bounds168 initial registers/thread; native SASS must confirm USETMAXREG. Compiler spill cost is measured explicitly.
